description.blurb: Orus is an asteroid located in the orbit of Jupiter, always orbiting "ahead" of Jupiter by sixty degrees. Referred to as a Trojan asteroid, It will be visited by the Lucy mission in November of 2028.
description.more: The Lucy mission will fly by Orus in November of 2028. Lucy will be able to compare this larger 51 km (31.7 mile) diameter Trojan to both the smaller Leucus, which is of the same type of very dark, very red objects thought to be rich in organics and carbon, and to the similarly-sized, but different spectrally typed, Eurybates.
